//! Writes the genuine pre-change schema 11 fixtures the adjustable-dose migration is tested
//! against. Run only from an isolated copy of the tree **before** the schema changes; the
//! snapshots it writes are what that build actually produced, not a struct relabelled as old.
//!
//! Two worlds, both from the default config and its own seed:
//!
//! * `care-v11-shower-*`: fed, cleaned, then rained on, checkpointed **mid-shower** so the
//!   migration has to resume an unfinished rain, and continued 600 ticks.
//! * `care-v11-hunters-*`: an actual hunter trial founded and stepped, fed once, checkpointed
//!   and continued 600 ticks, so the migration is exercised against a real schema 11 extension.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use cubarium_core::care::{CareCommand, CareKind, CareTarget};
use cubarium_core::hunter::{FixedHunterProfile, HunterTarget};
use cubarium_core::{CareOutcome, SCHEMA_VERSION, World, WorldConfig, encode_snapshot};
use cubarium_surface::{Face, SurfacePoint};

const BUILD: &str = "pre-dose-fixture";

fn target(face: Face, u: f64, v: f64) -> CareTarget {
    let p = SurfacePoint::new(face, u, v);
    CareTarget { face: p.face.index() as u8, u: p.u, v: p.v }
}

fn care(world: &mut World, seq: u64, kind: CareKind, at: CareTarget) {
    let tick = world.tick();
    let receipt = world.apply_care(&CareCommand { seq, apply_after_tick: tick, kind, target: at });
    println!("  seq {seq} {:?} at tick {tick}: {:?}", kind, receipt.outcome);
    assert!(
        !matches!(receipt.outcome, CareOutcome::Rejected(_)),
        "the fixture needs this command to land"
    );
}

fn step_to(world: &mut World, tick: u64) {
    while world.tick() < tick {
        world.step();
    }
}

fn write(dir: &PathBuf, name: &str, world: &World) {
    let bytes = encode_snapshot(&world.state, BUILD);
    let path = dir.join(name);
    std::fs::write(&path, &bytes).expect("write the fixture");
    println!(
        "  wrote {name}: schema {SCHEMA_VERSION}, tick {}, {} bytes, population {}",
        world.tick(),
        bytes.len(),
        world.population()
    );
}

fn main() {
    let dir = PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory"));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("the output directory");
    assert_eq!(SCHEMA_VERSION, 11, "this generator writes the pre-change schema");

    // ---- a world with care history and an unfinished shower
    println!("shower world:");
    let mut world = World::new(WorldConfig::default()).expect("defaults are valid");
    step_to(&mut world, 100);
    care(&mut world, 1, CareKind::Feed, target(Face::Top, 20.0, 20.0));
    step_to(&mut world, 200);
    care(&mut world, 2, CareKind::Clean, target(Face::Front, 30.0, 30.0));
    step_to(&mut world, 300);
    care(&mut world, 3, CareKind::Rain, target(Face::Top, 40.0, 40.0));
    // Mid-shower: 60 of its 120 samples are gone.
    step_to(&mut world, 360);
    let shower = &world.care().showers[0];
    println!("  shower seq {} delivered {}/120", shower.seq, shower.delivered);
    assert_eq!(shower.delivered, 60, "the fixture needs an unfinished shower");
    write(&dir, "care-v11-shower-360.cubw", &world);
    step_to(&mut world, 960);
    assert!(world.care().showers.is_empty(), "the shower finished during the continuation");
    write(&dir, "care-v11-shower-360-plus600.cubw", &world);

    // ---- a world with an actual hunter trial
    println!("hunter world:");
    let mut world = World::new(WorldConfig::default()).expect("defaults are valid");
    step_to(&mut world, 50);
    let profile = FixedHunterProfile::lanternjaw_trial(world.config());
    let receipt = world
        .start_hunter_trial(profile, HunterTarget { face: 4, u: 32.0, v: 32.0 })
        .expect("the trial starts");
    println!("  founder {:?}, imported {} m / {} e", receipt.id, receipt.material_in, receipt.energy_in);
    step_to(&mut world, 120);
    care(&mut world, 1, CareKind::Feed, target(Face::Top, 24.0, 24.0));
    step_to(&mut world, 200);
    assert_eq!(world.hunters().members.len(), 1, "the fixture needs a live member");
    write(&dir, "care-v11-hunters-200.cubw", &world);
    step_to(&mut world, 800);
    write(&dir, "care-v11-hunters-200-plus600.cubw", &world);
}
